claims: Will Smith won his first Academy Award for Best Actor at the 94th Oscars on March 27, 2022, for his role in King Richard.
Will Smith struck presenter Chris Rock during an onstage altercation.
Will Smith struck Chris Rock after a joke about Jada Pinkett Smith.
Will Smith resigned from the Academy.
Will Smith released a video apology.
The Academy banned Will Smith from the Oscars and all other Academy events for 10 years.
Will Smith received a Best Actor nomination for Ali (2002).
Will Smith received a Best Actor nomination for The Pursuit of Happyness (2007).
